Thus \(\mu=0\) has exactly one equilibrium. Substitution into the general characteristic coefficients gives \(\lambda^2(\lambda^2+1769/1904)\), so the origin has a double zero and a nonzero purely imaginary pair. These computations are symbolic and were replayed with exact rational arithmetic. The claim is explicitly limited to the source's equilibrium-level zero-Hopf definition and does not infer generic bifurcation conclusions from the spectrum alone.
